project.name: Modular FastAPI Starter Backend
project.author: Ngusa
project.summary: A production-ready FastAPI starter template built around a clean, domain-modular layout. Ships with JWT authentication, a user-management module, SQLAlchemy ORM, and environment-driven configuration. Intended to be cloned and extended — each new feature lives in its own module under app/modules/.

techStack.technology: JWT via python-jose, passwords hashed with bcrypt

repositoryLayout.description: template — copy to .env before first run
Entry point — FastAPI instance, CORS, router mounting
pydantic-settings — reads .env into typed Settings object
SQLAlchemy engine, SessionLocal, Base, get_db() dependency
User, UserOut, UserUpdate, UserCreate Pydantic models

modules.name: app/main.py
modules.title: Application Bootstrap
responsibilities: Instantiates FastAPI with metadata from settings
Mounts auth_router at /api/v1/auth and user_router at /api/v1/users

modules.name: app/core/config.py
modules.title: Centralised Settings
modules.description: Settings extends pydantic_settings.BaseSettings. All values read from .env at startup. Singleton settings object imported wherever config is needed.

modules.name: app/db/database.py
modules.title: Database Layer
modules.description: Creates SQLAlchemy engine (check_same_thread=False for SQLite), SessionLocal factory, declarative Base. get_db() generator is the FastAPI dependency injected into every route needing a DB session.

dataFlows.name: Forgot / Reset Password
steps: POST /forgot-password {email} → create_reset_token(email) → Return token (TODO: email it)

apiEndpoints.description: Create a new user account. Body: User schema (email, username, hashed_password).
OAuth2 form-data login. Returns access_token + token_type.
Generates a JWT reset token for the given email. Email delivery is a TODO.
Accepts a valid reset token and new password; updates the DB record.
Returns all users. *Currently unauthenticated — restrict before production.
Partially updates the authenticated user (username, email, password).

dependencyWiring.provides: A scoped Session that auto-closes on response

notes: user/routes.py currently calls verify_token() inline rather than using get_current_user(). For new protected routes, prefer the get_current_user dependency — it's the canonical pattern. (Verified accurate against source.)

databaseModel.warning: The project does not yet use Alembic for migrations. Table creation must be triggered manually (e.g. Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)).

localSetupChecklist: Clone the repo and cd into it
Create a virtual environment: python -m venv .venv
Generate a secret key: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))" → paste into .env as SECRET_KEY
Point DATABASE_URL to your PostgreSQL instance — or use sqlite:///./database.db for local dev
Create DB tables (no Alembic yet — add Base.metadata.create_all(engine) to main.py temporarily, or use a script)
howToAddNewModule: Create app/modules/<name>/ with models.py, schemas.py, routes.py, services.py, __init__.py
Define your SQLAlchemy model inheriting from Base (imported from app.db.database)
Create an APIRouter in routes.py and protect routes with Depends(get_current_user) where needed
Mount the router in app/main.py: app.include_router(my_router, prefix="/api/v1/<name>", tags=["<Name>"])

knownGaps.gap: Reset token is returned in the response body — no email delivery implemented yet
GET /api/v1/users/ has no auth guard — exposes all users publicly
No Alembic setup — schema changes require manual intervention
No token revocation / refresh token flow
Password helpers exist in both user/models.py and auth/services.py — consolidate to avoid drift. (Verified accurate against source.)
